faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Maillardville?

faq.q: Is Maillardville a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 12% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.a: 21 duplexes sold in Maillardville between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,285,000.
